title: Partisan voter model on complex networks: Dynamics of local ordering
summary: We investigate the processes of local ordering for the partisan voter model on complex networks. In this model, agents hold a binary opinion and a fixed preference that biases updates toward alignment with their preferred opinion. We first study the dynamics on uncorrelated random networks and derive a pair approximation that resolves the densities of links connecting different classes of agents.
